[Bug]: keep-mode pause stops pending KV receive polling with HiSparse/NIXL
candidates.snippet: `pause_generation(mode="keep")` can stop decode-side KV completion polling before asynchronous receives finish. With HiSparse mixed DRAM/VRAM NIXL reads, this also prevents the decode worker from sending completion notifications to prefill, leaving prefill waiting for remote cleanup during its own pause.  The deployment that exposed this uses GLM-5.3, B300, DP/EP=8 per replica, NIXL P/D, HiSparse on decode, and MooncakeStore through MultiConnector. This was investigated on a patched v0.28.1 deve

candidates.title: Cannot get the log probability of a specific token unless it ranks in top_logprobs
candidates.snippet: ### The problem  `logprobs`/`top_logprobs` can only report tokens that rank within the model's top-K guesses. There is currently no way to ask "what is the log probability of token X at this position" when X is not a top guess.  This blocks a common pattern: scoring a fixed candidate set in a single forward pass, without generating. Routing/classification/eval workloads prompt for a one-token answer and read the probability of each candidate label (`Yes`/`No`, a small label set, `A`/`B`/`C`/`D`
